methods_quotes.q: Data were weighted to adjust for nonresponse at both the student and school level
SUDAAN (version 8.0) was used to calculate prevalence estimates and standard errors for 95% confidence intervals (CIs).
SHS exposure was compared among middle and high school students by demographics, tobacco use, presence of close contacts who smoke, and attitudes toward SHS.
Schools were selected for participation in the survey with a probability proportional to the number of students enrolled.
